CustomObject.label: Direct Manager (Discount Approval)
CustomObject.description: SCRUM-445: Mapping of a sales rep to their direct manager. The role hierarchy is not usable here (measured: UserRole has 18 standard roles, every ForecastUserId null), so the direct manager is derived from this mapping object. Sales management maintains one record per rep; DiscountApprovalTrigger resolves Opportunity.OwnerId -> Rep__c -> Manager__c.
